incidents.name: GAIN transfer-fee burn from pair
incidents.notes: GAIN's transfer took its fee out of the recipient pair's balance, so a loop of dust transfers followed by pair.skim()/sync() drained the GAIN reserve and let the attacker buy back the pool's WETH cheaply.

sources.ref: onchain review: GAIN 0xdE59b88abEFA5e6C8aA6D742EeE0f887Dab136ac created 2022-07-21T12:33:28Z by 0x62e346c7b61a751355d2246e84bbb6b161d3c1c3, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment (580.2 days). ~18 ETH x $2,902.00 at incidentTimestamp 1708537763 (DefiLlama) = $52,236.
